title: Would anyone be interested in dialogue generation tool + voiceover which integrates with game engines?
author: Soulsticesyo

comments.author: Soulsticesyo
comments.body:
I'm developing a tool for creating dialogues, assigning voiceovers and testing in the editor, which then integrates into Unity, Unreal and Godot.

It has no AI integrations yet, but I'm considering adding MCP server to let users generate dialogues with their LLM + integrate ElevenLabs for voiceovers etc. Would anyone be interested?  
  
The app would remain a one-time purchase and you will be able to connect to it using Codex/Claude Code - I'm not charging extra for credits.

Steam: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/4088380/StoryFlow\_Editor/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4088380/StoryFlow_Editor/)

Website: [https://storyflow-editor.com/](https://storyflow-editor.com/)
